### 8–16s — B09-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · SAMPLE — Is the comparison set honest?. Define seasons, object types, images, dates, sources, missing records, and selection criteria before describing a pattern. Do not cherry-pick only the most recognizable work.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B09-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · CODE — What exactly recurs?. Code silhouette, proportion, material, construction, color, gesture, image, language, casting, and refusal as separate observable fields. Keep description distinct from interpretation.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B09-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · EXCEPTION — What does change reveal?. Record deliberate departures, commercial compromises, collaborator interventions, technical limits, and failed experiments. Exceptions show whether the method governs more than a motif.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B09-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CLAIM — What may be said or protected?. Separate cultural recognition, creator testimony, trademark evidence, product-design trade dress, copyrightable expression, design rights, and unresolved legal questions. Route protection claims to jurisdiction-specific counsel.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
